_comment: SKETCH ONLY (M0) — intended config shapes for the roles/groups/routing overhaul. Not referenced by any test and not parsed as RouterConfig. Each section names the milestone that implements it.
_m1_role_split: One roles table, two typed blocks. Residency/KV-window keys live in role.context; sampling overlay in role.params. Membership stays on roles.<r>.models (role side); models never list roles for membership.
_m1_model_override: models.<m>.roles is params-only sparse override per role (never membership). Optional; wins when present.
_m2_chain: Single ordered chain, each leg through overlay_params (shallow, wholesale wins), role applied once: classification-duty params -> group-selected model -> model.params -> role.params -> models.<m>.roles.<r>.params. Declaration keys stripped at the body boundary.
_m2_thinking: Additive thinking control: filter_thinking bool stays byte-identical; optional thinking (off | on | <model-specific string>) resolves model -> role -> model-role-override. Explicit thinking wins over the bool with a warn; filter_thinking:true === thinking:off.
_m3_terminal: Terminal assigns group (weights ladder) plus subordinate role (profile within the winning model's effective_pool). role None behaves as today. Classifier-duty role stays on the classifier path only.
_m4_lookup: Bare model resolves routes -> model_groups -> models, first hit wins. Boot warns naming every shadowed key. model:<key> bypasses the order.
_m5_last: last is session-scoped recency: (session, group) -> wire id. Unknown session falls back to group head with audit reason last-empty-fallback. Static resolution keeps skipping sentinels.
_m6_safety: Top-level safety_threshold is the optional default; per-classifier-node safety_threshold wins; absent both -> hard defaults (coherence 0.70, safety 0.5).
_m7_concurrency: roles.<r>.concurrency.max_parallel enforced via shared Limiter/CreditGatedPool; absent means unbounded. Boot warns when max_parallel exceeds the sum of instance slots.
_m8_gate: Schema derived from the types (never checked into env/); loader prints FATAL <file>:<line>:<col> <json-path> <what; expected>; run_start fails closed pre-spawn on (a) schema/defaults/coherence, (b) references/weights/self-routing, (c) per-route dry-run.
_m9_ls: coral-router ls prints routes single-row table, then groups single-row table, then per-model rows; --json is the lossless path; ps untouched.
_m10_fixtures: Hermetic unit/golden tests assert over checked-in fixtures only; make router-mock remains the single suite reading the operator's real file.
